rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice when a rule or authority makes someone ineligible or officially disqualifies them.

example.english: Breaking the rules will disqualify you.
example.jyutping: wai4 gwai1 zau6 wui5 ceoi2 siu1 zi1 gaak3

rows.note: Use this colloquial expression when someone is disqualified and removed from a competition or contest.

example.english: Breaking the rules will disqualify them from the contest.
example.jyutping: keoi5 faan6 gwai1 bei2 jan4 tek3 ceot1 guk6 laa3

rows.traditional: 令 A 唔符合資格
rows.jyutping: ling6 A m4 fu4 hap6 zi1 gaak3
rows.note: Use this when a condition or characteristic makes A ineligible, especially outside a competition.

example.english: The age limit will disqualify applicants.
example.traditional: 年齡限制會令申請人唔符合資格。
example.jyutping: nin4 ling4 haan6 zai3 wui5 ling6 san1 cing2 jan4 m4 fu4 hap6 zi1 gaak3
